description: Cuban cooking centers on citrus and garlic, rice, and olive oil. Fresh lime, chili heat, and masa or rice — brightness against rich proteins.

attributes.micro_lesson: Char chilies and tomatoes, bloom cumin in fat, finish with cilantro and lime never cooked long.
attributes.shopping_tip: Dried chilies, cumin, corn products, and fresh lime are non-negotiable.
flavor_building: Start with olive oil as your cooking medium.
Season with citrus and garlic — toast or bloom in fat when using ground spices.
Build the plate around rice as the anchor.
cultural_notes: Respect Cuban food as living tradition — learn context, not just copycat recipes.
